Affiliation between donor and recipient

Source: R/features.R
add_affiliation.Rd

Records whether the donor and recipient belong to one family of organizations. This is kept separate from the transaction label: about a third of two-party mergers and two-thirds of multi-party mergers in 2019-21 were between affiliated organizations.

Usage

add_affiliation(fl, sr = NULL, sa = NULL, header = NULL)

Arguments

fl

Filing table from sn_filings().

sr

Schedule R Part II rows (SR-P02-T01-ID-RLTD-TAX-EXEMPED-ORGS) with EIN2 and SR_02_RLTD_ORG_EIN.

sa

Schedule A Part I rows with EIN2 and SA_01_PCSTAT_SUPPORT_ORG_X.

header

Header rows with EIN2 and F9_00_GROUP_EXEMPT_NUM.

Value

fl with AFF_SCHED_R, AFF_SUPPORT_ORG, AFF_GROUP, and AFFILIATED (any of the three).
